editorial:
Ryder and his team of rescue pups head to Adventure City when Mayor Humdinger starts causing trouble. The city is big and busy, and the pups have to step up their game to keep everyone safe. You get to see familiar faces like Chase, Marshall, and Skye, plus a new friend named Liberty who knows the city well. The movie feels bigger and brighter than the TV show, with more action and heart. It is colorful, loud, and packed with fun moments that kids will love.

The animation looks sharp, and the voice cast does a great job bringing the pups to life. The story moves fast, so you never get bored, though some jokes land better than others. Younger kids might find a few scenes a little intense, but nothing too scary. If you are looking for a fun family movie night, this is a solid pick.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mayor Humdinger's fireworks show goes wrong and threatens the city. Chase overcomes his fear and helps save the day, proving he is brave enough for Adventure City. Ryder and the pups stop the chaos and Humdinger is arrested. Liberty officially joins the team, and the pups celebrate their new home base. It ends on a happy note with everyone safe and ready for the next rescue.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventures and animated heroes.
